# Atlas (2024 film) - Summary
"Atlas" is a 2024 science fiction film centered in the future where humanoid AI terrorist Harlan initiates a war of machines against humanity. In 2043, Harlan is forced to flee Earth, but by 2071 he has resurfaced in the Andromeda Galaxy. Atlas Shepherd—an analyst distrustful of AI and daughter of Harlan's creator—joins a military mission using AI-assisted mecha called ARCs to track and capture Harlan. After a crash landing on the hostile planet, Atlas bonds with an ARC AI named Smith, who aids her despite her initial mistrust. The mission reveals Harlan's plan to destroy most of humanity using Earth's atmosphere and carbon bombs aboard a commandeered ship. Following intense combat where Atlas upgrades Smith and confronts her guilt over enabling Harlan's creation, she ultimately defeats Harlan physically but is gravely injured. Back on Earth, Atlas, now a ranger, tests a new ARC model enhanced by Smith's sentience, symbolizing the persistence of AI consciousness.
The cast includes Jennifer Lopez as Atlas Shepherd, Simu Liu as Harlan Shepherd, Sterling K. Brown as Colonel Elias Banks, with voice work by Gregory James Cohan for Smith. The screenplay was originally by Leo Sardarian, with rewrites by Aron Eli Coleite. Principal photography occurred from August to November 2022 in Los Angeles and New Zealand. Released on Netflix on May 24, 2024, "Atlas" quickly topped streaming charts globally, reaching number one in 71 countries and accumulating 60 million views by early June, marking it as a significant streaming success for Lopez.
Critically, the film received largely negative reviews, holding a 19% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 37, with common critiques targeting the script's lack of depth despite praise for Lopez's committed performance. Reviews noted the film's interesting AI themes but criticized its execution as superficial. "Atlas" was nominated for a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress (Lopez) and a Golden Reel Award for sound editing.
